name: kustomize-navigator
description: Navigate and manage Kustomize references in your Kubernetes manifests

kustomizeNavigator.highlightFluxVariable.description: Enable highlighting of Flux variable substitutions

kustomizeNavigator.fluxVariableColor.description: Color to use for highlighting Flux variables

kustomizeNavigator.kustomizeApiColor.description: Color to use for Kustomize API version labels

kustomizeNavigator.fluxApiColor.description: Color to use for Flux API version labels

kustomizeNavigator.standardFluxVariables.description: Standard Flux variables to suggest in autocompletion

kustomizeNavigator.diagnostics.enabled.description: Enable or disable all diagnostic checks

kustomizeNavigator.diagnostics.checks.re.description: Check resource names against Kubernetes naming conventions

kustomizeNavigator.diagnostics.checks.na.description: Check if namespaced resources have a namespace specified

kustomizeNavigator.diagnostics.checks.re.description: Check for recursive dependencies in Flux kustomizations

kustomizeNavigator.diagnostics.checks.im.description: Check for hardcoded image tags or missing tags

kustomizeNavigator.diagnostics.checks.se.description: Check for common security issues like privileged containers

kustomizeNavigator.diagnostics.checks.fl.description: Check for deprecated Flux API versions

kustomizeNavigator.diagnostics.checks.gi.description: Check if essential GitOps components are present

kustomizeNavigator.diagnostics.checks.pe.description: Check for configurations that might cause performance issues

kustomizeNavigator.diagnostics.checks.va.description: Check for Flux variable substitution issues

kustomizeNavigator.diagnostics.checks.de.description: Warn about deprecated patch fields (patchesStrategicMerge, patchesJson6902)

kustomizeNavigator.validateReferencePath.description: On Windows and macOS, warn when a reference path matches only case-insensitively (would fail on Linux / Flux). Uses native realpath and a directory walk.

enableFileSystemCache.description: Enable file system operation caching for improved performance (50-80% reduction in I/O operations)

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
